'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
